purpose: Source receipt for the representative visible paved widths used by js/waterfront-island-road-materials.js. This is source-informed typology, not an exact City Road Edge footprint relocation.

source.name: City of Toronto Topographic Mapping - Edge of Road
source.note: The layer is named Road Line but its geometryType is esriGeometryPolygon. Geometry maintenance is 2021-01-01, not a current survey guarantee.

method: Perpendicular cross-sections through the mapped OSM ways, intersected with the Road Edge polygons; EPSG:3857 lengths scaled by cos(lat) to ground metres. Nearby (not only centre-containing) samples are reported.
nativeOsmWidthNote: 6.4 m is the OSM living_street class default, not a measured width. The native metadata width is left unchanged.
alignmentNote: The City Road Edge polygons are offset from the OSM centre line in places (up to ~3.5 m near the SE end of Oneida). The representative strips are centred on the existing OSM frame; the alignment drift is not resolved here.
decision: Use a bounded representative visual paved width of 3.3 m (Oneida) and 3.5 m (Ojibway) centred on the existing OSM lane frame, with grass shoulders on the same StreetLevel plane. No routing, metadata width, collider, ground-height or geometry change.
